guidelines.heading: Tutoring Guidelines
paragraphs: During semesters, the schedule below outlines the regular tutor on duty each night and the courses for which they can provide tutoring services.
Tutors will be present during the scheduled times in Roger Bacon 350 or an alternate location that you can find posted in RB 350.
You will be asked to scan a QR code which will bring you to a Google form you will need to use to sign in.

groupSchedule.heading: Group Tutoring Schedule
groupSchedule.note: Tutoring is scheduled each week during the active semester; check posted updates in RB 350 for any changes.

studentSignIn.title: Student Sign-In
studentSignIn.description: Scan this QR code to open the signup form.
